methods.name: Stage-Progression
methods.rationale: Applies typical Series A → next-stage step-up multiplier (2.0x) to $58M total raised proxy.

methods.name: Peer-Median
methods.rationale: Median across 4 same-sector + same/adjacent-stage peers in Robotics & Manufacturing. Range: $1.1B - $2.0B.

data.narrative:
Verdant Robotics is a Series A robotics and manufacturing company founded by Gabe Sibley and Curtis Garner that has raised $58M to date. The valuation analysis benchmarks against a peer set of 4 private companies at Series B and Seed stages (Generalist AI, Bedrock Robotics, Dexterity, and Walden Robotics), supplemented by a broader comp universe of 8 private firms and 1 public comparable.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, using total capital raised as a proxy for current value and applying a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A to subsequent-stage advancement, yields $116M. Peer-median analysis across the 4-company robotics and manufacturing comparable set (range: $1.1B to $2.0B) implies $1.7B, reflecting the elevated valuations observed in downstream Series B financings within this sector. The peer-median method carries material weight given the stage and sector overlap, though the sample includes one Seed-stage outlier at $1.1B.

Triangulation across both methods supports a valuation range of $99M (floor) to $2.0B (ceiling), with a median of $908M. The wide dispersion reflects genuine uncertainty around (1) whether Verdant's technology and market position warrant Series B+ multiples, (2) the relevance of downstream-stage comparables to pre-Series B pricing, and (3) capital efficiency relative to peers. Further diligence on revenue traction, customer concentration, and technical differentiation would narrow this range materially.
